svg.title: The Open Loop Line: the Open Loops Task states as a transit map
svg.desc: Stations: Backlog (Owner only), Ready, Working, In Review and Done. A Respawn loop goes from In Review back to Working through a gate that only a trusted author passes; other comments go to a dead-end spur and are skipped. A Blocked branch returns to Ready. A Gated siding holds a Ready Task until its upstream Task is Done. Four illustrative Tasks ride the line; each one takes the color of its state.
